scenarios.title: Example Operations
scenarios.description: Shows the output of various OpenCV operations over live camera frames.

controls.name: OperationComboBox
controls.expected: Populated with 5 OperationType values: Blur, HoughLines, Contours, Histogram, MotionDetector; SelectionChanged updates current operation + CurrentOperationTextBlock.

controls.name: OutputImage
controls.expected: Displays the OpenCV-processed frame for the selected operation (hardware-gated).

actions.effect: Selecting an item sets currentOperation and rewrites CurrentOperationTextBlock text.

scenarios.hardwareGated: Camera capture (MediaCapture / MediaFrameReader). Without a camera the app must show a graceful fallback, not a blank/broken page.

notes: Extract-UwpFeatureChecklist reported 0 controls/0 actions (the extractor did not parse the ComboBox); this rubric records the real controls read from the XAML + code-behind and is used for the manual visual/behavioral judgment.
